# Aixuno Compress — File Compressor

> Free browser-based file compressor for images, PDF, video, audio, archives and fonts. Files are processed locally in the browser and are never uploaded to an Aixuno server.

## Site

- Name: Aixuno Compress (formerly FilePomelo)
- Homepage: https://compress.aixuno.com/
- Purpose: compress and convert files without uploading them
- Languages: Simplified Chinese (https://compress.aixuno.com/zh/), English (https://compress.aixuno.com/en/)

## Tools

- Image compressor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/image-compressor
- PDF compressor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/pdf-compressor
- Video compressor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/video-compressor
- Audio compressor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/audio-compressor
- ZIP compressor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/zip-compressor
- ZIP extractor: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/unzip
- Image format converter: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/image-converter
- Font subsetting: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/font-compressor
- All tools: https://compress.aixuno.com/en/tools

Chinese versions replace `/en/` with `/zh/`.

## Key facts

- Compression runs on the user's device; no file is transferred to a server.
- No account or sign-up is required, and usage is free.
- Supported formats include JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, SVG, PDF, MP4, WebM, MP3, WAV, ZIP and common font files.
- Video and PDF pipelines use WebAssembly workers (ffmpeg, Ghostscript) that load on demand.

## Related Aixuno sites

- https://aixuno.com — Markdown and document conversion
- https://image.aixuno.com — image editing and conversion
- https://pdf.aixuno.com — PDF tools
- https://bg.aixuno.com — background removal
